title: Set Home page key metrics to specific static values

requirements.text: Update ONLY the selected Total P&L value element at XPath /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/main[1]/div[1]/section[2]/div[1]/div[1]/div[2]/div[1]/span[1] (a <span> in HomePage) to display the exact static text "$17.5" (include the $ sign), keeping it as a <span> and not adding any additional formatting or computed/fallback values.

quotes: In total P&L make $17.5 make dollars logo in total trades make 1 and make Winning Trades 1

acceptanceCriteria: On the Home page, the Total P&L value <span> renders exactly "$17.5" as plain text.
The element remains a <span> and only this selected element’s content is changed.

requirements.text: Update ONLY the selected Total Trades value element at XPath /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/main[1]/div[1]/section[2]/div[1]/div[3]/div[2]/div[1] (the Total Trades value container on HomePage) so that it displays the exact static text "1" (no computed value, no fallback logic) while keeping the element type unchanged.

quotes: In total P&L make $17.5 make dollars logo in total trades make 1 and make Winning Trades 1

acceptanceCriteria: On the Home page, the Total Trades value renders exactly "1" as plain text.
Only the selected element is changed; other cards/labels/layout remain unchanged.

requirements.text: Update ONLY the selected Winning Trades value element at XPath /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/main[1]/div[1]/section[3]/div[1]/div[1]/div[2]/div[1] (the Winning Trades value container on HomePage) so that it displays the exact static text "1" (no computed value, no fallback logic) while keeping the element type unchanged.

quotes: In total P&L make $17.5 make dollars logo in total trades make 1 and make Winning Trades 1

acceptanceCriteria: On the Home page, the Winning Trades value renders exactly "1" as plain text.
Only the selected element is changed; other sections/cards remain unchanged.

constraints: Apply changes ONLY to the three user-selected elements identified by the provided XPaths.
Do not modify any read-only (immutable) frontend paths.
Do not change backend behavior or data models for this request.
nonGoals: Changing any other metrics (e.g., Win Rate, Total Capital, Max Drawdown).
Making these values editable from the UI or driven by backend data.
